title: NeurIPS accepts One Step is Enough
body: Zijian Zhao and Sen Li study one-step policy optimization for assigning rides across a fleet.

title: Triple-BERT accepted at ICLR
body: Zijian Zhao and Sen Li examine whether a single reinforcement learning agent can handle order dispatch on ride-sharing platforms.

title: Jing Gao joins The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
body: Dr. Jing Gao, a graduate of the group, started a position as Research Assistant Professor.

title: Yitong Shang promoted to Research Assistant Professor
Paper on regulating for-hire autonomous vehicles accepted
body: “Regulating For-Hire Autonomous Vehicles for an Equitable Multimodal Transportation Network” was accepted by Transportation Research Part B: Methodological.

title: Paper on multimodal charging networks accepted
body: “Towards a Multimodal Charging Network: Joint Planning of Charging Stations and Battery Swapping Stations for Electrified Ride-Hailing Fleets” was accepted by Transportation Research Part B: Methodological.

title: Paper on operating mixed ride-hailing fleets accepted
body: “Planning and Operation of Ride-Hailing Networks with a Mixture of Level-4 Autonomous Vehicles and For-Hire Human Drivers” was accepted by Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies.

title: Paper on regulating mixed ride-hailing fleets accepted
body: “Regulating Transportation Network Companies with a Mixture of Autonomous Vehicles and For-Hire Human Drivers” was accepted by Transportation Research Part A: Policy and Practice.

title: FedPT-V2G paper accepted by Applied Energy
body: “FedPT-V2G: Security Enhanced Federated Transformer Learning for Real-time V2G Dispatch with Non-IID Data” was accepted by Applied Energy.

title: Paper on the economics of food delivery platforms accepted
body: “An Economic Analysis of On-Demand Food Delivery Platforms: Impacts of Regulations and Integration with Ride-Sourcing Platforms” was accepted by Transportation Research Part E: Logistics and Transportation Review.

title: Group helps organize the 26th HKSTS International Conference
body: The Hong Kong Society for Transportation Studies and HKUST jointly held the conference on 12–13 December 2022.

title: Tingting Dong and Yitong Shang join the group
body: Tingting Dong and Yitong Shang joined as postdoctoral researchers.

title: Paper on labor regulation for ride-sourcing platforms accepted
body: “An Analysis of Labor Regulations for Transportation Network Companies” was accepted by Economics of Transportation.

title: Mixed autonomous fleet study receives funding
body: The Young Scientist Fund of the National Natural Science Foundation of China funded “Managing Mobility-on-Demand Services based on Level-4 Autonomous Vehicles: Coordination of Mixed Fleets and Regulation on Ride-Sourcing Platforms.”

title: Yulong Hu and Shunpeng Yang join the group
body: Yulong Hu and Shunpeng Yang joined as students.

title: Paper on ride-sourcing and preassigned pooling accepted
body: “Coordinating Supply and Demand in Ride-sourcing Markets with Pre-assigned Pooling Service and Traffic Congestion Externality” was accepted by Transportation Research Part E: Logistics and Transportation Review.

title: Tourist coach parking study receives funding
body: PICO’s Public Policy Research Funding Scheme funded “Regulating Tourist Coach Parking in Hong Kong: Curbside Management and Carpark Provision.”

title: Equitable autonomous mobility study receives funding
body: The General Research Fund of Hong Kong’s Research Grants Council funded “Regulating For-Hire Autonomous Vehicles towards an Equitable Mobility Future.”

title: Paper on shared electric vehicle pricing and fleet management accepted
body: “Optimal pricing and fleet management for shared electric vehicle in coupled power and transport networks” was accepted by Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies.

title: Paper on on-demand valet charging accepted
body: “On-demand valet charging for electric vehicles: economic equilibrium, Infrastructure Planning and Regulatory Incentives” was accepted by Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies.

title: Paper on shared parking and cruising traffic accepted
body: “Shared parking for ride-sourcing platforms to reduce cruising traffic” was accepted by Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies.

title: Multimodal transportation regulation study receives funding
body: The Early Career Scheme of Hong Kong’s Research Grants Council funded “Regulating Transportation Network Companies in Multimodal Transportation Systems.”
